verdict.rationale: PostHog is a SaaS analytics platform with AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions training-data policies, opt-out controls, or data-use guarantees for AI models. The cited AI features (MCP server, LLM analytics) are adjacent and do not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
